records.context: A senior monk confronts Maria's search for the Proof. She is unsure of her ultimate reason but wants to keep it from powers seeking Asian domination. He criticizes hostility toward Westerners, then sees deep sorrow and love for her people as righteousness/compassion. He describes a Chinese map-guardian clan fleeing an old ruler to a far northeastern village near icy seas and warns that ordinary ships may not reach it. His descendants' continued residence is expected, not confirmed firsthand. He warns Maria against hatred and evil desires as well as evil possessors; preserve his moral challenge and her subdued response.

scoped_name_term_andreadaloud_amendments.before: Through the power of science! Science uses human understanding to shed a little light on the wonders of this world that lie beyond it.
scoped_name_term_andreadaloud_amendments.after: Through science! We use human reason to shed a little light on the wonders of this world that lie beyond our understanding.
scoped_name_term_andreadaloud_amendments.reason: Read-aloud refinement removes an ambiguous it that could refer to the world rather than human understanding, preserving science's limited explanatory ambition.
